requirement_evidence.evidence: Recorded compiler environment: pdfTeX 3.141592653-2.6-1.40.28 (TeX Live 2025/Debian), BibTeX 0.99d, pdftoppm 24.08.0.
Compiled inside isolated /tmp build directory using standard multi-pass workflow. Copied final PDFs strictly to canonical Week 4 delivery paths without overwriting Weeks 1-3.
Verified zero fatal layout errors, no missing glyphs, no unresolved citations, and no clipped tables.
Rendered all 11 physical pages (Report A: 5 pages, Report B: 6 pages) to 150 DPI PNGs and visually inspected equations, tables, and page breaks.
Bound exact source, bib, compiler logs, and rendered page SHA-256 hashes in pdf_review.json.
Maintained direct linkage between TeX sources, CSV tables, and compiled PDFs.
Retained temporary rendered PNGs in /tmp outside git version control while binding hashes in review receipt.

limitations: Final delivery archive bundling and repository-wide deliverable checksum verification occur in W4-040.
